job.beschreibung:
YOU ARE
You define how process transformation work gets done within your industry or function — setting the methodology, governing quality, and making sure every engagement reflects deep domain expertise as well as the right delivery standard. You manage and develop your team, coach senior specialists on what good looks like in your domain, and connect with technology and delivery partners to make sure the process and platform work fit together.
You've made AX Design, the intersection of human, agent, and process part of the team's methodology — you've worked out how to apply it in your domain context, and you coach your team on what human+AI agent experience design looks like in practice.
THE WORK
Embed AI into future state design for clients as well as in ways of working for your full workstream using the appropriate AI tools and creating agents strategically to aid in deliverable creation.
Define the process redesign standard for your industry or function — the method the team uses to assess domain forces, specify future-state processes, integrate AI, and design operating model changes — and govern its application across all engagements in your area.
Determine the client facilitation approach: discovery workshop methodology, recommendation presentation standards, and approval governance.
Define the benchmarking and transformation roadmap methodology the team applies.
Determine how domain expertise and functional playbook methodology are applied consistently across the team's portfolio of engagements.
Manage client stakeholder facilitation activities — discovery workshops, recommendation presentations, and day-to-day relationship management.
Approve final process designs before client delivery.
Manage and develop direct reports; coach senior specialists on process redesign, domain application, and senior leadership presentation.
Connect with technology and delivery partners to make sure process design and platform work fit together on joint deliverables.
Define how AX Design is embedded in the team's domain methodology — establishing the standard for how AI agent experiences are specified, reviewed, and validated within process transformation deliverables across all engagements.
Who You Are
Bachelor's Degree or equivalent qualification
Considerable experience in process excellence, process redesign, or management consulting
Deep industry expertise in at least one domain (e.g., Banking/Capital Markets, Insurance, Software and Platforms, Communications and Media, High Tech, Health, Public Service, Life Sciences, Consumer Goods Retail and Travel, Industrial, Energy, Utilities or Chemical and Natural Resources), with the ability to apply it to transformation methodology design
Proven experience managing and developing team members in a consulting environment
Well versed in building, evaluating, and scaling AI-enabled solutions into client work with the ability to explain how AI addresses business problems
Proven track record facilitating client workshops and presenting to senior leadership
Strong executive communication and facilitation skills
​
Preferred Experience
Demonstrated ability to define and govern team methodology across a portfolio of client engagements
Familiarity with process mining, digital twin, or AI-assisted design tools for process validation
Experience contributing to business development, leadership proposal and facilitating client workshops
Demonstrated ability to embed AI Design into team delivery standards — governing how AI agent experiences are specified and validated across process transformation engagements
Understand AI partner ecosystem and help clients navigate complex technology choices
What We Offer
Flexible working models with hybrid working options that support your individual lifestyle and preferences.
Continuous learning opportunities including leading AI, transformation, and leadership development programmes.
The opportunity to work with global clients on large-scale AI powered transformation initiatives that shape entire industries.
The Accenture Culture: Here, YOU are the catalyst for change
Your unique combination of skills, personality, and aspirations sets you apart. When distinct talents, strengths, and perspectives merge, the result is nothing short of extraordinary: ideas that propel the world forward. This is why we champion diversity and personal development at Accenture. Create a working environment where you truly thrive; with responsibilities that resonate deeply; with a workload that is perfectly aligned with your capabilities; and methods that are tailored to your objectives. How you wish to connect, further your development, and personally evolve rests in your hands. This is your career. We are mere facilitators, helping you shape it exactly as you envision.
About Accenture
Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. Technology is at the core of change today, and we are one of the world’s leaders in helping drive that change, with strong ecosystem relationships. We combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise and global delivery capability. Our broad range of services, solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Song, together with our culture of shared success and commitment to creating 360° value, enable us to help our clients reinvent and build trusted, lasting relationships. We measure our success by the 360° value we create for our clients, each other, our shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
